messages.subject: Meetings this quarter: 10-12 Fridays
parts:
Hi all,

This quarter we will meet on Fridays 10-12 in Wickson 2124.  Our first meeting, this this Friday the 9th, will be an open work session with a quick introduction for new members.

I am looking for volunteers to cover some dates.  Please let me know if you would be interested in running a D-RUG meeting.

Here are some of the talks we have lined up for this quarter:

 - Michele Tobias on making maps with leafletR
 - Carl Boettiger on accessing online data repositories with ROpenSci packages
 - Our own Vince Buffalo shows the best of his new book, Bioinformatics Data Skills
 - Debugging and problem-solving strategies by Yours Truly

We have requests for talks on: boosted regression trees (gbm/dismo packages), plotting with ggvis, a return to ggplot, and getting the most out of RStudio.  If you're interested in covering any of these topics (or others!) let me know.

Best,

Noam
